The Black Knights

Led by Zero (Lelouch vi Britannia)

Geass Order

Led by V.V.

A secret organization dedicated to researching and cultivating Geass users. Led by V.V., the Order operates from a hidden base and has existed for centuries, manipulating world events from the shadows.

Knights of the Round

Led by Bismarck Waldstein (Knight of One)

The twelve most powerful knights in the Britannian Empire, answering directly to the Emperor. Each holds a title corresponding to the Knights of the Round Table from Arthurian legend.

Japan Liberation Front

Led by Lieutenant General Katase

The main Japanese resistance group before the rise of the Black Knights. Composed of former Japanese military personnel, they fight using guerrilla tactics but are eventually absorbed into the Black Knights.
